## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy-header test should be fixed because its input never reaches header validation. The parser change enforces the intended header, and the separate complete-report test exercises rejection of an unsupported version.

(none)

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:10 — tests — For the generated input `REPORT v1\nversion=v0`, `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes even when legacy headers are accepted. The replacement changes the payload, while the missing `END` causes rejection before header validation. Use a complete report and change its header to `REPORT v0`. — This test provides no regression protection for the version check it claims to guard.
